name: item
behavior: None of its own — a content-row primitive. Inside a group the wrapper takes role=list and each item role=listitem; an interactive item adopts the semantics of the element it renders as (link or button) and is then a single tab stop with its own focus ring. It never invents roving focus — a selectable collection is listbox/tree, a different pattern.

parts.statesNote: hover/selected only apply when the item is interactive; selected uses interaction-selected + on-interaction-selected per states.md

parts.note: leading avatar, framed glyph or thumbnail; top-aligns when a description is present
stacks title over description; takes the remaining inline space
trailing slot — hosts buttons or a menu trigger; its children keep their own tab stops
rule between items in a group (anatomy/separator.json)

anatomyNotes: Salt has no Item component; the closest shapes are Option (list row) and InteractableCard (framed row), which between them cover the same parts — media, content/title/description, actions. shadcn's variant default|outline|muted decomposes onto prominence: default → ghost (transparent), outline → outline (border), muted → solid (surface fill). Item is card's row-shaped sibling: same content parts, control-scale spacing and radius instead of container-scale.
